watch.text: Watch how this learner uses the app.

red.text: When the border is red, the learner just listens, and says nothing.

avec_b.text: the border turns green, and the learner says the answer at the same time as the teacher. Listen to both voices together.

again.text: Again. Together, at the same time.

vasy_b.text: the border turns green, and the learner says only the answer, on their own.

only.text: The learner never repeats what the teacher says. They only say the answer, and only when the border is green.

yourturn.text: Now it's your turn. Speak clearly and loudly.
